ScientificClaim.claimText: 20 mRNAs are differentially expressed in breast cancer tissue.

RationaleArtifact.rationaleText: The claim is based on the identification of 20 mRNAs with AUC ≥ 0.9 and p < 0.0001 from ROC curve analysis.
RationaleArtifact.keyEvidenceSummary: These mRNAs were selected from an initial pool of 1,445 candidates identified as significantly differentially expressed in breast cancer tissue.
uncertainties: The claim does not specify the exact nature of the differential expression (up- or down-regulation).
The confidence level is based on the strength of the evidence and may be subject to revision.
